title: Multicultural Tea Party｜Social Intelligence Laboratory, Ritsumeikan University

summary.lead: A multicultural tea party was held at the Social Intelligence Lab!

overview: The Social Intelligence Laboratory is a multinational laboratory with Assistant Professor Ampere from Thailand and students from China and Indonesia. Therefore, we decided to hold a multicultural tea party by bringing sweets and tea from each country! There were drinks and sweets from various countries, including Chinese tea, coffee-flavored candies popular in Southeast Asia, Indonesian wafers and crushed peanut snacks, and Japanese Yatsuhashi and Nure-Senbei (rice crackers). Everyone enjoyed talking about their impressions of each country's flavors and culture while eating sweets and drinking tea they had never seen before🎵
